sid-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：萨尔机场的跑道铺在佛得角萨尔岛的干旱海岸上，航站楼与机坪在跑道东侧。
sid-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Sal's runway lies on the arid coast of the Cape Verde island, with the terminal and apron east of the field.

sid-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 橙色与白色的航站楼前，蓝色雨棚上写着 Partidas 与 Departures，旅客正走过斑马线。
sid-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Beneath a blue canopy marked Partidas and Departures, travellers cross the striped road in front of the orange and white terminal.

sid-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 俯瞰图中，航站楼与塔台坐落在干燥的红土平原上，前方停车场整齐排列着车辆，远处是大西洋。
sid-chatgpt-02.webp.en: From above, the terminal and its control tower sit on arid ground behind rows of parked cars, with the ocean on the horizon.

sid-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架机身前部写着 CABO VERDE 的客机停在机坪上，移动登机梯已靠上舱门，地勤人员正在作业。
sid-chatgpt-03.webp.en: An airliner lettered Cabo Verde on its forward fuselage stands on the apron with mobile stairs at its door and ground staff working around it.

sid-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 航站楼长长的立面上嵌着橙框玻璃窗，屋顶上蓝色大字拼出机场名称，路边停着一辆银色轿车。
sid-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Orange-framed windows run along the long terminal facade, blue rooftop letters spelling the airport's name above a road where a silver car waits.

sid-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 航拍显示白色帐篷式雨棚旁的机坪上停着两架小飞机，塔台在左下方，跑道与停车场分布四周。
sid-chatgpt-05.webp.en: An aerial view shows two small aircraft parked beside a white tent canopy, with the control tower to the lower left and the runway beyond.

sid-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 一架尾翼与发动机呈橙红色的客机正面停在滑行道上，灰色云层压得很低，地平线平坦空旷。
sid-chatgpt-06.webp.en: An airliner with orange tail and engine nacelles faces the camera on the taxiway beneath an overcast sky, the flat horizon empty around it.
